author: hcnem
body:
Hello everyone!

As you may know, we have recently opened up Senior Moderator positions. We have decided to promote 5 Moderators to the position of Senior Moderator. These 5 have worked very hard throughout their time as Mod, and definitely deserve the position. Without further ado, I'd like to congratulate MLGPorky, Colecrc, Blizzem_, Iron and GalaxyBrit on their promotion! Well deserved! :)

http://avicus.net/staff

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body: No, they just stay Mod. The Sr. Mod interview isn't pass/fail. We already have an idea of who we'd like to promote, more or less a recommended list of Mods. The interview is simply to see where everybody is at and how they each can handle the role.
